content.comment_body: Hello, I developed a macro-free Excel tool called "PolynomRegressionDynamisch_[product_name]_V2.xls" in the German forum. This tool calculates polynomial coefficients based on user-input date pairs (between 2 and 4000 entries) in a separate sheet. The user defines the polynomial order and the value range for the 'b' coefficient on a dedicated sheet. Using Excel matrix functions, it computes a compensation polynomial over the entire x-value range and, after specifying parameters for a segment of x-values, calculates a further polynomial for a subsection of the data. This allows users to break up the total data set into smaller segments and approximate each with a low-order polynomial, making it suitable and programmable for [product_name] modules. The numerical formats are specifically customized for [product_name]. The example data uses a sine curve, and a lot of information about polynomial regression with Microsoft Excel is available online. Example applications include calculation of time functions and determining absolute humidity from temperature and relative humidity measurements. See my answers in the German post: [url] Best regards [user_name]
